verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Today NASA announced the four astronauts that will fly on board Artemis II" (R1); "The crew, NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch, along with CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R2); "Four astronauts could launch" (R3); "the four astronauts of the NASA mission Artemis II" (R4); "Four astronauts have been selected for NASA’s Artemis II mission" (R5); "The four-person crew of Artemis II" (R6); "The crew of four astronauts" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references explicitly state the crew consists of four astronauts.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman is the commander of the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (R1); "NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman" as commander (R2 context); "Wiseman will command the Artemis II mission" (R3); "Mr. Wiseman, 50, the mission’s commander" (R4); "Commander Reid Wiseman" (R5, R7); "Commander Reid Wiseman" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant references directly identify Reid Wiseman as commander.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover is the pilot of the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot Victor Glover" (R1); "Glover serving as pilot" (R3); "pilot Victor Glover" (R5, R7); "Pilot Victor Glover" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in multiple sources confirm role.

verifications.claim: Christina Hammock Koch is a mission specialist on the Artemis II mission.

verifications.evidence: "mission specialist Christina Koch" (R1); "Christina Koch ... mission specialists" (R2, R3); "mission specialist Christina Koch" (R5, R7); "Mission specialist Christina Koch" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated across sources; full name matches R1.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is set for a 10-day lunar flyby mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "approximately 10-day test flight ... around the Moon" (R2); "10-day journey that will take them swinging around the moon" (R3); "10-day flight around the moon" (R6); "approximately 10-day mission ... around the Moon" (R7)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will test the Orion spacecraft's systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "fly aboard Orion to test out its systems" (R1); "checking out Orion’s systems along the way" in deep space context (R2); "check out Orion’s systems ... in the actual environment of deep space" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for testing Orion systems during the mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human return to the Moon's vicinity since 1970.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "return humans to the vicinity of the Moon for the first time in over 50 years" (R1); "for the first time in more than 50 years" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References support first return in over 50 years (approximating to early 1970s), but do not specify '1970'; broader temporal description.

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Christina Hammock Koch is the first woman assigned to a lunar mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon" (R1); "first woman ... on a lunar mission" (R3)

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is the first non-US citizen to fly on a lunar mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first Canadian to go to the Moon" (R1); "first Canadian on a lunar mission" (R3, R6)
verifications.reasoning: First Canadian implies first non-US, as prior lunar missions were US-only.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to fly farther from Earth than any previous human mission.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "could set a record for the farthest ... depending on launch day" (R2); "could send the group farther ... surpassing the Apollo 13 distance record" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Supported as possible ('could'), but conditional on launch, not definitively scheduled.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will test systems intended to support long-term exploration of the Moon and beyond
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "paving the way to return humans to the Moon to walk on the lunar surface" (R1); "pave the way for long-term exploration and science on the lunar surface" (R5, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Direct link to testing for long-term lunar and deep space exploration.
